name: The Resurrected Man
overview: Qadir and Qumru are a happy family. Babir, an influential person in the region where they live, falls in love with Qumru and seeks various ways to get her away from Qadir. Babir tries to get rid of Qadir by sending him to work in a distant place. However, Qadir, who survived the assassination attempt, returns to the city to take revenge.
